commits.author: Copilot
commits.message:
Quote PostgreSQL schema/table identifiers in metadata-derived SQL names (#948)

Quote PostgreSQL metadata-derived schema and table identifiers so numeric-leading, case-sensitive, Unicode, and embedded-quote names render safely.

Adds focused regression coverage for numeric-leading and Unicode identifiers.

fix(pg): resolve boolean type casting in filters

Updated BaseDialect to return native Java Boolean objects. This prevents PostgreSQL from throwing type mismatch errors when parsing RSQL filters. Added regression test in PgReadControllerTest.
